figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: one discipline - say what you measured, in what units, to what precision
figures.read: every result is a dimensional formula, an error sum, or a reading minus zero error

figures.title: Homogeneity: every term must match
figures.why: the cheapest error detector in the subject
figures.data: s=ut+½at²: every term [L]; s=ut+at: last term [LT⁻¹] (wrong)
figures.read: add only same-dimension terms; a mismatch is a free rejection

figures.title: Dimensional analysis as an exponent hunt
figures.why: the whole method is one loop - guess, match exponents, solve
figures.data: pendulum: a=0, b=½, c=-½ gives T ∝ √(L/g)
figures.read: matching exponents ships the form but never the 2π

figures.title: The three errors: precision is not accuracy
figures.why: naming the error before fixing it is half the answer
figures.data: systematic = off-centre cluster, random = scattered, gross = outlier
figures.read: clustering fixes the wrong problem when the error is systematic

figures.title: Linearise, then read the slope
figures.why: a straight line is the only graph a ruler can read
figures.data: y=axⁿ → ln y = n ln x + ln a; pendulum T²=(4π²/g)L
figures.read: log a power law, plot T² for the pendulum; the slope is the constant

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: definitions give dimensions, dimensions give errors, a line gives the slope
